question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The company implemented a new ________ to improve efficiency.
solution:
```html
The correct answer is '**strategy**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**strategy**" refers to a plan of action designed to achieve a long-term or overall aim. (रणनीति)
 
• The correct spelling of the word is "**strategy**" and not "**stratagy**," "**strategi**," or "**strategie**."
 
• The sentence implies that the company implemented a well-thought-out plan or strategy to improve its efficiency.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The company implemented a new strategy__ to improve efficiency.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Stratagy:** Incorrect spelling of "strategy."
 
• **Strategi:** Incorrect spelling of "strategy."
 
• **Strategie:** Incorrect spelling of "strategy."

```
